interpretation.linuxOther: Residual after selected categories are subtracted from resident-minus-shared memory. It does not assign allocation owners and is not total process PSS.
interpretation.zeroCategories: Linux conditional and limited accounting cannot prove absence of graphics, DOM or allocator memory.
interpretation.layerTreeMemory: Separate backing-store estimate; not an allocation census and not additive to native categories or PSS.
interpretation.contextClose: Old context is actually closed; raw PIDs show a different WebKit content process. The fall is not in-process garbage collection.

singleNativePressureEvent: non-critical; not evidence of physical phone pressure or crash cause
